episode_title: Ep #419: Navigating Success: From Startup to Thriving Enterprise

real_qa.q: How has HolistaPlan grown since winning the XYPN FinTech competition in 2019?
real_qa.r: In 2019, HolistaPlan was a two-person team consisting of Roger Pine and co-founder Kevin Mosier, with only a part-time contractor providing 10 hours per week. Today, the company has grown to approximately 100 people. Roger emphasizes that while this represents significant growth, 100 employees is still not an enormous number compared to major companies, and the team had to systematically make themselves obsolete in their original roles by bringing in directors and VPs better suited to those functions.

real_qa.q: What are the key opportunities Roger Pine sees for the future of financial advice technology?
real_qa.r: Roger identifies AI as the major shift transforming the advice industry, noting that he is now 50 times more efficient at writing code using AI tools. He also mentions the persistent promise of the single pane of glass — everything in one place — and suggests there may be a real chance it actually happens this time. He indicates HolistaPlan will be releasing more on this direction within the next few months.
real_qa.requete: future of advice tech AI single pane of glass
